warning[ZBX-W0701]: writing a bundle without redaction
  cause  --no-redact keeps environment values and secrets in the bundle
  fix    read every file in it before you share it, or leave --no-redact out
  more   zbx explain W0701 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0701.html
